licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the full distribution by separating the major clusters: fraud/deceit in obtaining licenses or fees, criminal convictions, clinical quality failures (negligence, malpractice, substandard care), non-clinical ethical/moral misconduct (sexual, immoral, dishonorable conduct, fee-splitting), substance impairment, physical/mental incapacity, aiding or employing unlicensed persons, false or deceptive advertising, and the large residual of procedural/administrative noncompliance (board orders, reporting duties, record-keeping, infection control, continuing education, etc.).

profession_specific.sedation_anesthesia_.rationale: These eight buckets map directly onto the standard sedation depth continuum (local → minimal → moderate → deep → general anesthesia), plus the administratively distinct nitrous-oxide/inhalation category, facility-level permits, and a small catch-all for specialty items (mobile anesthesia providers, radiology, cosmetic surgery, contracted providers) that don't fit the depth ladder.
